spans.s:
Man, mankind.
E.
भू to be, क्यु Uṇādi aff.

A master or lord.
E.
भू to be, Uṇādi aff. कन्युच्.

n. (-यं)
The three worlds: heaven, earth, and hell.
E.
भुवन, and त्रय triad.

m. (-कः)
One of the divisions of the universe, the space between the earth and the sun, and the haunt of the Siddhas, Munis, and other saintly beings.
E.
भुवस् heaven, and लोक world.

ind.
Heaven, æther, sky, or atmosphere.
E.
भू to be, Uṇādi aff. असुन्.

n. (-विः)
The ocean.
E.
भू to be, Uṇādi aff. इसि, and the radical vowel changed.
